title: Vercel AI Gateway cuts Grok 4.7 price 40% for one week
detail: Vercel added Grok 4.7 (spacexai/grok-4.7) to AI Gateway on September 21, 2026, with a 40% discount on input and output tokens that applies automatically through September 27. Discounted pricing is $1.20 per million input tokens and $3.60 per million output tokens. The model has a 500K token context window and is reachable through the AI SDK, the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API, and coding agents connected to AI Gateway, including fx, Cursor, Codex, Amp, and OpenCode.
impact: Anyone routing coding-agent traffic to Grok 4.7 through Vercel AI Gateway pays 40% less per token through September 27, with no code change needed since the discount is automatic. The rate reverts to standard pricing after that date unless Vercel extends it.
